design_reference: Editeur Livre-Jeu - Wireframes.dc.html § 02 « Éditeur — vue d'ensemble de l'arbre » (BINDING): top bar with book title + node count + « + Nœud »; dot-grid canvas; node cards with NodeBadge + ref + title + 1-line snippet; SVG connectors with arrowheads + mono edge labels; dashed-curve « fuite » relink edge; bottom-right zoom controls. Node marks from foundations/badges-nodes.html; cards/badges/tokens from styles.css. Low-fi, light theme.

plan.goal: Render the book as a navigable graph of node cards and labelled edges on a dot-grid canvas, with selection, pan/zoom, and the entry point to add a node — the primary editor surface.
acceptance_criteria: The canvas renders one card per node and one edge per relationship, read live from BookService; adding/removing/renaming a node or edge elsewhere updates the canvas without reload (driven by node:* / edge:* events).
Each node card shows its type via the correct NodeBadge mark, its ref, its title, and a 1-line snippet of its description.
Clicking a node selects it (accent border + ring) and emits node:selected{nodeId}; exactly one node is selected at a time; clicking empty canvas clears selection.
`choice` edges render solid and `relink`/`flee` edges render dashed; every edge shows its choice-label chip; the obligatory Mort node is reachable only via authored edges.
The canvas pans (drag) and zooms (controls + wheel); pan/zoom and the canvas↔outline view mode persist per book via UIPreferencesService and are NOT pushed to cloud sync.
« + Nœud » creates a new unattached node through BookService and selects it; the seeded empty book still shows Sommaire + Mort with an inviting affordance to author the first leaf.
Node positions are persisted (via BookService/PersistenceService) so the layout is stable across reloads; a position-less node gets a deterministic auto-layout slot rather than overlapping at 0,0.
Selecting a node here is what opens node-editor's side panel (via node:selected) — the canvas owns selection, not editing.
All chrome renders from design-system tokens/components, light theme; node cards stay legible at default zoom (title ≥ --fs-body).
plan.walking_skeleton: Read the open book from BookService, lay nodes out (stored position or auto-layout), draw cards + SVG edges on a dot-grid. Click a card → emit node:selected. Wire node:*/edge:* listeners to re-render. A faithful static graph with live selection.

iterations.goal: Faithful static render of § 02: cards with correct NodeBadge marks, refs, titles, snippets; solid/dashed SVG edges with arrowheads and centered label chips; top bar; zoom controls. DS fidelity pass.

Live data binding: render from BookService; subscribe to node:* / edge:* to update incrementally; « + Nœud » creates+selects a node; selection emits node:selected and is single-select with clear-on-empty-click.

Pan/zoom + layout persistence: drag-pan, wheel/control zoom (local, shipped), deterministic auto-layout for position-less nodes (shipped); PERSIST positions on drag + per-book view state via UIPreferencesService (not cloud-synced, KR-022) — deferred until UIPreferencesService lands.

Robustness at scale: virtualize / cull off-screen nodes for large books, avoid edge-label overlap, keep 60fps pan; guard against orphaned edges referencing deleted nodes (KR-021, partially shipped: orphans are dropped).

known_risks: KR-020 — The canvas is a VIEW, not the model: never mutate node/edge data locally; all changes go through BookService.
KR-021 — Orphaned edges must be dropped or visibly flagged, never rendered as a line to nowhere or a crash. Reconciled on every render via resolveEdges.
KR-022 — Pan/zoom and view-mode are UI preferences (UIPreferencesService), NOT part of the synced book document.
KR-023 — Node positions belong to the book document and must persist; position-less nodes use a deterministic layout (no random scatter, no 0,0 pileup).
KR-024 — Selection is owned here and broadcast via node:selected; node-editor must not own a competing selection source.
KR-011 — No raw window.localStorage; positions/view-state persist only through PersistenceService/UIPreferencesService.
KR-013 — Derive layout/selection state inline or via an external-store subscription, not via useEffect-synced mirrors of props.
Perf — large books must cull off-screen rendering and keep pan/zoom at 60fps; SVG edge count is the usual bottleneck.
A11y — node cards are keyboard-focusable and selectable; the canvas is not a keyboard trap.

iterations_log.label: walking-skeleton + iterations 1-2
architecture_choices: TreeCanvas is a pure VIEW over BookService (KR-020): useOpenBook subscribes to the brain event bus (book:opened, node:*, edge:*) and re-reads the persisted book via useSyncExternalStore — an external-store subscription, not a useEffect-synced mirror (KR-013).

Node mutation lives in BookService (the SSOT): BookService.addNode creates a free-floating node with a deterministic auto-layout slot (autoSlot, KR-023), persists, then emits node:created carrying the kind. The canvas never writes node/edge data itself.

Selection is owned by the canvas (single source of truth, KR-024): local single-select state, broadcast via node:selected{nodeId|null}; node-editor will react to it. Clearing on empty-canvas click emits node:selected null.

Geometry is pure and testable (layout/geometry.ts): resolvePositions falls back to autoSlot for position-less nodes; resolveEdges drops orphaned edges whose endpoints were deleted (KR-021) rather than drawing a line to nowhere.
Pan/zoom is local per-session UI state (useViewport) and explicitly NOT persisted/synced here (KR-022); persistence via UIPreferencesService is deferred to iteration 3.

node:created payload extended with `kind` (typed NodeKind) on the brain EventBus — a core domain event emitted by BookService, kept in brain (emitter-owned), consistent with the event-ownership boundary.
deviations_from_plan: Iterations 1 and 2 shipped together as the walking skeleton (faithful § 02 render + live binding + selection + « + Nœud »).

Iteration 3 split: local drag-pan + wheel/control zoom + deterministic auto-layout SHIPPED now; PERSISTING pan/zoom + dragged positions via UIPreferencesService DEFERRED until that service exists (mirrors book-creation iter 3 deferring on CloudSyncService).
New « + Nœud » nodes are seeded as `choix` (a neutral authored screen); retyping happens later in node-editor.
The side panel shown in wireframe § 02 belongs to node-editor (next feature); tree-canvas only emits node:selected to drive it.

test_coverage.unit: BookService.addNode (free-floating, deterministic position, persist-before-emit, unknown-book null); geometry (stored vs auto-layout positions, orphaned-edge drop, label midpoint)
test_coverage.integration: TreeCanvas render (title/count/cards/empty-state placeholder), single-select + node:selected, clear-on-empty-click, « + Nœud » create+select+count via BookService

resolved_decisions: Editor scope only: « Aperçu du jeu ▷ » is play/book-launch mode (out of scope) — rendered disabled.
Canvas owns node selection (single source of truth); node-editor reacts to node:selected.
Pan/zoom + canvas↔outline view mode are local UI preferences, not synced.
Auto-layout for position-less nodes is a deterministic diagonal cascade keyed by node index (no random scatter, no 0,0 pileup).
« + Nœud » creates a FREE-FLOATING unattached node (kind `choix`), then selects it; attaching to a parent choice is done in choice-linking.
open_questions: UIPreferencesService: persist per-book pan/zoom + view-mode + dragged node positions (iteration 3) when the service lands.
Outline view-mode switch is specced in the top bar but owned by outline-view; wire the toggle when that feature lands.
